concepts.name: Quiet continuation
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Direction name: Quiet continuation. Create a realistic, production-quality mobile Quran reading app home screen, high fidelity, one screen only, logical dimensions 390 x 844, portrait. Attached screenshot is the ACTUAL current product: use it as a reference for content, Russian language, forest green brand, calm pale paper background and Arabic surah-name typography. This is a new design concept rather than an edit. App content ONLY: no phone body, bezel, rounded external mask, notch, OS status bar, clock, battery, home indicator or surrounding presentation. Fill the canvas naturally at 390:844 aspect ratio.
Product purpose is ONLY reading, listening and lightly memorizing Quran; no prayer times, tasks, streaks, statistics, achievements, notifications or social features.
Design a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. One clear primary action and only one or two supporting content areas. Do not add panels, cards, tabs, badges, metrics, filters or navigation merely to advertise features. Use spacing, typography and restrained dividers first. No cards inside cards. No heavy shadows. Body UI 14–16 logical px. Contemporary native iOS refinement, legible Russian, lots of quiet spacing but still a practical library.
Brand tokens: background #F7F8F5, surface #FFFFFF, muted surface #EEF2ED, text #101513, secondary #5F6965, accent #1F6F5B, weak accent #DDECE6. Rounded controls 14–20 logical px. No more than two font families including Arabic.
Structure: title “Коран” top left, small gear icon right. Then a strong but tastefully restrained continuation section with tiny eyebrow “ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ”, title “Аль-Бакара”, subtitle “Аят 255 из 286”, and a modest exquisite cream-and-forest-green closed Quran book illustration on the right (no invented sacred writing). Primary button “Читать” with a simple book icon; secondary unobtrusive “Слушать” action with headphones icon. The illustration is small, serving hierarchy, not a giant hero.
Below: quiet search field “Сура или аят, например 2:255”. Then “Суры” section title and understated segmented links “Все”, “Заучиваю”, “Выучено”. A spacious flat list with slender row dividers, numbers in small pale circles, Russian titles and small verified surah names copied from the attached screenshot: “Аль-Фатиха” / “7 аятов”, “Аль-Бакара” / “286 аятов”, “Аль Имран” / “200 аятов”, “Ан-Ниса” / “176 аятов”. Only one subtle green bookmark icon on a saved surah; remove repeated bulky “Не начал” controls entirely. Arabic names may be taken directly from reference; do not render Quran verse text.
Keep enough of the list visible. All text sharp, properly spelled and aligned, all controls comfortably tappable. No bottom tab bar, no bottom player in this inactive listening state. No extraneous English labels or annotations. This is a design preview, not a functional screenshot. Current date is 2026-10-15; no dates are displayed.

concepts.name: Personal library
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Direction name: Personal library. Create a realistic, production-quality single mobile Quran app home screen, high fidelity, logical canvas 390 x 844, portrait. The attached image is the actual CURRENT APP, a reference for Russian content and calm forest-green brand. Generate a substantially different hierarchy from a hero-led page: a compact, practical library with personal shortcuts and more visible surahs. App content only, no phone frame/body/bezel/notch, no OS status bar/clock/battery/home indicator, no browser UI, no external drop shadow or rounded device mask.
Purpose is only Quran reading, listening and simple memorization. No dashboard, no prayer times, gamification, tasks, calendar, streaks, stats or promotions. Focused primary screen, not feature inventory: one continuation action, one small row of user-saved shortcuts, then the surah list. No big photographic hero and no giant illustrations.
Design language: refined minimal native iOS, background #F7F8F5, surfaces #FFFFFF and #EEF2ED, forest green #1F6F5B, weak green #DDECE6, near-black #101513, secondary #5F6965. Use typography, alignment and whitespace first; thin row dividers. No cards inside cards, no heavy shadows, minimal borders. Body type 14–16 logical px; Arabic surah names may be copied from screenshot but no full verse text.
Structure: title “Коран” at top left, small gear right. Search just below, placeholder “Название суры или 2:255”.
Below search, a SLIM continuation band on pale green: small book icon, title “Аль-Бакара”, secondary line “Продолжить с аята 255”, a discrete right arrow. This whole row is a clear reading action, no secondary CTA.
Then understated section “Закреплено” with only two horizontally arranged small rounded text shortcuts, bookmark icons, labels “Ясин” and “Аль-Мульк”. They are easy access items, not data metric cards.
Then a line with heading “Все суры” and small “114” aligned right. Keep existing status filtering as a small understated segmented switch “Все”, “Заучиваю”, “Выучено” just above the list; no additional new filters.
Show flat readable surah rows, subtle separators, each has tiny circle number, title, Arabic name and ayah count, discreet trailing chevron. Exact Russian rows: “Аль-Фатиха” / “7 аятов”; “Аль-Бакара” / “286 аятов”; “Аль Имран” / “200 аятов”; “Ан-Ниса” / “176 аятов”; “Аль-Маида” / “120 аятов”. Fit 4–5 rows naturally, no cropped text. Remove all repeated bulky “Не начал” controls. A user-learning surah may have a tiny unobtrusive green dot as secondary status, no badge per row. No bottom tab bar and no player in this inactive-listening state. Keep excellent negative space, readable text, comfortable touch targets and precise alignment. No annotations, extra English text, or decorative filler. Current date 2026-10-15; no dates displayed.

concepts.name: Listening continuity
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Direction name: Listening continuity. Create ONE polished production-quality mobile Quran app home screen concept, logical dimensions 390 x 844, portrait, one screen filling canvas. Actual app screenshots attached: image 1 shows current HOME and image 2 current READER with recently implemented repeat/pause/speed player controls. These are visual/content references, NOT edit targets. Preserve the quiet forest green visual family and Russian language but create a new composition centered on returning to a memorization passage while listening remains available on the home screen. App content ONLY; no phone hardware, bezel, device shadow, rounded external phone mask, notch, OS status bar, clock, battery, home indicator or browser chrome.
Focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. Goal ONLY Quran reading/listening/simple memorization. No prayer times, dashboards, productivity tasks, goals, streaks, progress percentages, badges, or social feed. Only a short section to resume a chosen passage, a surah list and a persistent mini player. Do not add a separate continue reading hero and bookmark row on top of these; do not crowd.
Visual tokens from app: #F7F8F5 background, #FFFFFF surface, #EEF2ED muted surface, #101513 text, #5F6965 secondary, #1F6F5B forest accent, #DDECE6 weak forest accent. Strong typography, fine dividers, 14–16 logical px body, precise comfortable touch targets, generous but functional spacing, very little shadow. Avoid every row becoming a card, no cards inside cards. Native mobile refinement. All Cyrillic text exact and readable, no stray English labels. Arabic surah names may follow screenshots, but no full Quran verses and no invented scripture.
Top bar: “Коран” left, small magnifier and gear icons right. Search is an icon in this direction to preserve space; tapping it would expand an inline search. The concept does not need to show the expanded search.
One soft-green horizontal feature section near top: tiny repeat icon and label “ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ ПОВТОР”, title “Аль-Бакара”, subtitle “Аяты 5–10 · По кругу”, a prominent but restrained rounded primary action “Повторить”. A small abstract circular repeat symbol rendered as a tasteful cream-and-forest-green 3D object on the right, not full-size imagery. This is a saved passage, not a timed task. Limit section to about 180 logical px tall.
Below: “Суры” then a subtle segmented control “Все”, “Заучиваю”, “Выучено”. Flat list with 4–5 visible rows if space allows: numbered small circles and exact Russian titles “Аль-Фатиха” / “7 аятов”, “Аль-Бакара” / “286 аятов”, “Аль Имран” / “200 аятов”, “Ан-Ниса” / “176 аятов”, “Аль-Маида” / “120 аятов”. No large “Не начал” controls, only chevrons.
Bottom anchored slim white mini player above safe bottom area, separated by fine top divider: small waveform/book icon, “Аль-Фатиха” in medium weight and “Аят 2 из 7 · Аль-Афаси” in small secondary text; simple circular green play button on the right, a tiny secondary close button, thin green progress line. This is a paused audio session. Keep player at about 70 logical px, no full transport controls, no repeat/pause/speed settings on home: tapping mini player would expand into the reader. No bottom navigation bar. Leave appropriate bottom content inset so mini player does not cover list text. Current date 2026-10-15; no dates shown. No annotations or additional panels.
